metadata.description: A per-repo knowledge-graph plugin for Claude Code. Source-derived code maps with cross-codebase parity linking. Advisory only.

plugins.name: codebase-kg
plugins.description: Builds, maintains, and serves a per-repo knowledge graph — a structured, source-derived map of any codebase (nodes = components with symbol anchors, edges = relationships) so an agent can orient and find code without re-deriving the map every session. Language-agnostic: node `kind` is free-form, source reading is agent-driven, all per-repo specifics live in config. Cross-codebase parity: a node links directly to its counterpart in another repo's KG, carrying a parity status + one-line divergence, so 'find all feature gaps' is a query across both graphs. Ships a markdown KG schema, skills (build/refresh/audit/link/validate), an MCP query surface, and advisory post-edit freshness hooks. Advisory, never blocking — a code mirror, descriptive not prescriptive, source-derived not ticket-derived.
